name: dsh-mud-agent
description: MUD agent plugin for deepseek-harness (pkuxkx): tool-mud (bundle) + mud-webui (web shell), hosted as an independent npm package workspace

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter mud-link --filter mud-sense --filter mud-commands --filter mud-combat --filter mud-nav --filter mud-flows --filter mud --filter tool-mud build && pnpm --filter mud-workflow build && pnpm --filter mud-workflow --filter mud --filter tool-mud typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter mud-link --filter mud-sense --filter mud-commands --filter mud-combat --filter mud-nav --filter mud-flows --filter mud --filter tool-mud --filter mud-workflow --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-mud-webui test
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter mud-workflow --filter mud-commands --filter tool-mud run build && pnpm --filter tool-mud gen:typert && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-mud-webui build && pnpm --dir D:/Code/deepseek-harness dsh web --patch D:/Code/dsh-mud-agent/packages/mud/tool-mud/cordis.patch.yml --port 3082
